sources.title: D'Angelo, Ballio & Ravazzani (2025), 'Geomorphologic risk factors for river bridges', IJDRR, database supplementare S3

curation_note.it: Il rapporto ARPAE registra sul Santerno a Borgo Tossignano un colmo di 2,49 m s.z.i. il 16 maggio contro la soglia 3 di 2,00 m. Poiché la posizione del ponte nel database resta approssimata o non verificata, ARCUS non calcola una distanza né rappresenta la misura come livello alla sezione collassata.
curation_note.en: The ARPAE report records a 2.49 m peak above the local gauge datum on the Santerno at Borgo Tossignano on 16 May against a 2.00 m threshold 3. Because the bridge position in the database remains approximate or unverified, ARCUS neither computes a distance nor represents the measurement as the collapsed-section stage.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official validated event report and ARPAE station registry

caveats: Stage values are relative to the Borgo Tossignano gauge datum and are not water depth or absolute elevation.
The bridge location is approximate or unverified, so no station-to-bridge distance or directional relationship is asserted.
The observation is same-watercourse basin context and is not transferred to the collapsed bridge section.
No discharge is assigned because no validated event-specific stage-discharge conversion is used here.
The scour classification remains tied to the cited database source and is not proved by the hydrometric peak alone.
